record_title: Arbitrary-field online representations for strong linear matroid secretary
provenance: An arbitrary-field extension of the online-representation linear-matroid secretary theorem of arXiv:2609.20797 using its finite-signature modular-lattice argument.
limitations: No polynomial-time implementation is claimed. The theorem assumes a fixed finite-dimensional vector space, or more generally a fixed finite-rank modular ambient geometry whose closure and rank structure are available. Effective identification of constraint signatures over abstract or infinite-field representations is not analyzed. The 1/e constant is not improved. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with significant contemporaneous-work risk because the motivating strong-secretary manuscripts are extremely recent.
